records.name: Wrath Wave

provenance.where: Skill > Stigma > Wrath Wave tooltip, stigma Lv 1
provenance.note: Cooldown, MP, Specialty lines and Lv 1 text read from the tooltip. The Lv 5 line is cut off on screen after "more target".

specialties.text: Up to +20% damage when more targets are hit

records.text: Lv 1: deals 1345 to 1383 damage to up to 4 enemies within 5m of the caster, with a 50% chance to inflict Knockdown for 3s (100% on NPC targets). Instant cast, 4m range, Greatsword only.
